---
title: "Faceting in ggplot2"
subtitle: "facet_wrap() and facet_grid() — multi-panel plots with full strip customisation"
description: "Create multi-panel Trellis plots in ggplot2 using facet_wrap() and facet_grid(). Covers rows, columns, scales, direction, strip styling, panel spacing, and background highlighting."
---

## What is faceting?

Faceting splits your data into **sub-panels**, each showing a subset. It's one of ggplot2's most powerful features for comparing patterns across groups.

Two main functions:

| Function | Use when | Variables |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| `facet_wrap()` | One grouping variable (can do two) | Wraps panels into a 2-D grid |
| `facet_grid()` | Two grouping variables | Strict rows × columns matrix |

---

## Sample data

```r
library(ggplot2)

# Simulate data with 4 groups
set.seed(4)
x      <- runif(500)
y      <- 4 * x^2 + rnorm(length(x), sd = 5)
group  <- ifelse(x < 0.4, "G1",
           ifelse(x < 0.6, "G2",
            ifelse(x < 0.8, "G3", "G4")))
x      <- x + runif(length(x), -0.5, 0.5)
df     <- data.frame(x = x, y = y, group = group)

# All data coloured by group — can get crowded
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point()
```

---

## `facet_wrap()` — one variable

### Basic

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group)
```

### Control rows / columns

```r
# Force one row (four panels side by side)
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, nrow = 1)

# Force two columns
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 2)
```

### Free axis scales

```r
# All panels independent axes
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free")

# Free Y only
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_y")

# Free X only
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, scales = "free_x")
```

### Panel direction

```r
# Default horizontal fill (left→right, then next row)
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, dir = "h")  # default

# Vertical fill (top→bottom, then next column)
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, dir = "v")
```

### Strip (label) position

```r
# Default: top
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, strip.position = "top")    # default

# Bottom strip
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, strip.position = "bottom")

# Left / right
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, strip.position = "left")
```

### Highlight each group (show all data behind)

A powerful technique: draw all data in grey in every panel, then highlight the relevant group on top.

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  # All data in grey — remove group from this layer
  geom_point(data = transform(df, group = NULL), colour = "grey85") +
  # Highlighted group on top
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, strip.position = "bottom")
```

---

## `facet_grid()` — two variables

```r
# Simulate second grouping variable
set.seed(4)
x      <- runif(500)
y      <- 4 * x^2 + rnorm(length(x), sd = 5)
group1 <- ifelse(x < 0.4, "G1", ifelse(x < 0.6, "G2",
           ifelse(x < 0.8, "G3", "G4")))
group2 <- ifelse(y < 0.5, "A", "B")
x      <- x + runif(length(x), -0.5, 0.5)
df2    <- data.frame(x = x, y = y, group1 = group1, group2 = group2)
```

### Basic formula syntax

```r
# group1 ~ group2 → group1 in rows, group2 in columns
ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group1)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(group1 ~ group2)
```

### vars() syntax (modern)

```r
ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group1)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(group1), cols = vars(group2))
```

### One direction only

```r
# Only columns (rows free)
ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(. ~ group2)

# Only rows (cols free)
ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(group1 ~ .)
```

### Free scales

```r
ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group1)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(group1 ~ group2, scales = "free")

# Free only Y
ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group1)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(group1 ~ group2, scales = "free_y")
```

### Free panel sizes (when scales are free)

```r
ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group1)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(group1 ~ group2,
             scales = "free",
             space  = "free")   # "free", "free_x", "free_y"
```

## Strip customisation

### `facet_wrap` strips

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(
      face   = "bold",
      colour = "white",
      hjust  = 0,
      size   = 13
    ),
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill      = "#2d6be4",
      linetype  = "solid",
      colour    = "white",
      linewidth = 0.8
    )
  )
```

### `facet_grid` strips — x and y independently

```r
ggplot(df2, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(group1 ~ group2) +
  theme(
    strip.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "white", size = 12),
    strip.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "white", size = 12),
    strip.background.x = element_rect(fill = "#2d6be4"),
    strip.background.y = element_rect(fill = "#e84855")
  )
```

### Remove strip background

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, colour = "#0e0f14"))
```

---

## Panel spacing

```r
# Increase panel spacing
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group) +
  theme(panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"))

# Different h/v spacing
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group) +
  theme(panel.spacing.x = unit(2, "lines"),
        panel.spacing.y = unit(0.5, "lines"))
```

---

## Panel borders per facet

```r
ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y, colour = group)) +
  geom_point(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ group) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(fill = "transparent",
                                colour = "grey70",
                                linewidth = 0.6)
  )
```

---

## Full polished example

```r
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, colour = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(gear),
             nrow           = 1,
             labeller       = labeller(.default = function(x) paste0(x, " gears")),
             strip.position = "bottom") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("4" = "#e84855", "6" = "#2d6be4", "8" = "#12a36a"),
    name   = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  labs(title    = "Weight vs Fuel Economy by Gear Count",
       subtitle = "Colour = cylinder count · line = linear trend",
       x        = "Weight (1,000 lbs)",
       y        = "Miles per Gallon") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "top",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    panel.border     = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = "grey80"),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1, "lines"),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```

---

## Quick reference

| Argument | Values | Effect |
|----------|--------|--------|
| `nrow` / `ncol` | Integer | Force number of rows / columns |
| `scales` | `"fixed"`, `"free"`, `"free_x"`, `"free_y"` | Axis scale freedom |
| `dir` | `"h"` (default), `"v"` | Panel fill direction |
| `strip.position` | `"top"` (default), `"bottom"`, `"left"`, `"right"` | Label position |
| `space` | `"fixed"`, `"free"`, `"free_x"`, `"free_y"` | Panel size freedom (grid only) |
| `shrink` | `TRUE`/`FALSE` | Shrink scales to fit stat output |
| `drop` | `TRUE`/`FALSE` | Drop unused factor levels |
